task: Operator: 문 모션 없음 — add real open/close motion to DoorEntity (transform-based, no new sprite)
root_cause: DoorEntity.Update only did a colour brighten (sr.color *=1.25) on pass — no actual open/close motion. Operator flagged '문 모션 없음'.

approach.trigger: Unchanged. PawnMovement Update already calls DoorEntity.NotifyPassing() every tick the pawn is inside the door collider (#171). NotifyPassing() refreshes openHintTime; the slide reads that, no new wiring needed.
approach.motion: Real open/close slide: while wantOpen (Time.time - openHintTime < OpenHoldDuration 0.18s) target openness=1 else 0. Update lerps openness via Mathf.MoveTowards (asymmetric: OpenLerpRate 14 fast open, CloseLerpRate 8 slower close = settling feel).
approach.transform: smoothstep t = openness^2*(3-2*openness). localPosition.x = closedLocalPos.x + OpenSlideX(0.42)*t (leaf slides sideways); localScale.x = lerp(closedScaleX, closedScaleX*OpenScaleX(0.18), t) (leaf tucks/shrinks into frame). Closed pose captured ONCE in Awake (closedLocalPos, closedScaleX) so it always returns to the authored built transform.
approach.removed: Deleted the colour-brighten path and now-unused sr / baseColor fields (would have been CS0414 unused-assignment warnings). Replaced with true motion per operator request ('색 깜빡임 말고 실제 열림/닫힘 모션').

firewall_checks.no_4_audio_buzz: Added zero audio in the lerp loop. NotifyPassing()'s PlayDoor() is unchanged and already throttled 0.15s (DoorInterval) inside AudioBank — pre-existing, covered.
firewall_checks.no_per_frame_alloc: No new List/array/object alloc in Update; mutates cached Vector3 locals only.
firewall_checks.no_9_runinbackground: No coroutine / WaitForSeconds / background timer added. Pure Update transform interpolation — no AutoScreenshotter/runInBackground concern.
firewall_checks.no_5_no_6_no_7: No collision-instanceID compare, no OnCollisionEnter handler, no singleton OnEnable subscription added.

preserved.public_api: DefaultPassMul (const), passMul SerializeField, PassMul getter, SetPassMul(), IsInsideDoor(), PassMulAt(), NotifyPassing() — all unchanged signatures (V16AutodoorAreaCancelTest + PawnMovement + BuildManager depend on these).
preserved.virtual_awake: Awake stays protected virtual; AutodoorEntity.base.Awake() still runs (now captures closed pose + sets trigger). AutodoorEntity untouched — inherits the new motion for free.
preserved.requirecomponent: [RequireComponent SpriteRenderer/BoxCollider2D] kept — sprite still must exist to be visible/slidable.

qa_flags: Door leaf should slide sideways + narrow as a pawn passes, then slide/widen shut ~0.18s after the pawn clears. NOT a colour flash.
Door must return EXACTLY to its built cell pose when closed (closed pose captured in Awake; openness clamps to 0).
Autodoor (faster cross) closes faster in practice since pawn clears sooner; same motion code.

Confirm no door sprite drifts permanently — if BuildManager re-parents/moves the door AFTER Awake, closedLocalPos would be stale (current build path sets transform before AddComponent, so capture-in-Awake is correct).
